title: escape mall world via noclip? plus picture depicting the wasteland outside of the casino that looked like an infinant mall.
content: so im a bit odd my DEs unlike most peaople's who STOP them going lucid mine acutaly TAUGHT ME (or atleast the powerfull DEs) tho the weak DE's hate it. so i can no "noclip" in dreams, and while never been to "mallworld" pacifically, something DOSE fit the description though, the infinant anomalous hotels i find myself in in meany dreams, some i can enter and exit normaly and is somewhat anomalous can walk out and get to the city from the door, can noclip and find this city is NOT infinant but the hotel IS inside, some are super anomalous where ONLYWAY OUT is to goto a windowless room which unrenders the rest the fake "outside area" you end up in a black void, for me simmiler to GTA SA interior "heaven" but without yellow floaty markers. you then go into the interior and can walk outside normaly, escaping (forme) the infinant hotel, or perhaps the infinant mall. i did have one dream though where started in a green wasteland planet walked ended up in the place that is gold called "the casino" and its abolutly packed, but i did note "the casino" DID indeed LOOK LIKE A MALL it DID have LOTS of stores. and yes it was infinant but had this anomalous effect where at a point it would spit you back in the green wasteland, infact i made a picture on it which i will post its the green bottom part, although in the picture its part of another dimention where you look 360 down or up to get to the level below or above. could it be the hotels i find myself in are an "address" or a "location" of mallworld since are lots post saying there are hotels in the malls.
